title: Couple of Problems
text: Couple of Problems. This works pretty well and seems to be heavy and well made. The issues I dislike are the fact that you can't see a fuel level anywhere.  Most importantly I was unable to get this to bend at any angle and the instructions that come with it are useless. I don't want to damage the torch, but it would be really nice if it bent the way it is supposed to.

product_metadata.title: Butane Torch Refillable, Woputne Rotatable Head Blow Torch, Cooking Torch Adjustable Flame, Kitchen Culinary Food Torch for Creme Brulee, BBQ, Baking, Art Resin(Butane Gas Not Included)
features: ►Powerful Flame Gas Torch with Twistable Nozzle- flame temperature up to 1,300ºc. Light compact design, effortless one hand operation. Butane torch head can be rotated 180 degrees.

►Ideal for BBQ, lighting fire(camping/fire place), creating the finishing taste and color to dishes and desserts, such as caramelizing sugar atop creme brulee, melting cheese, toasting marshmallow and crisping joints of meat. Also Good for hobby, arts and DIY crafts projects, jewelry making, welding, soldering. (Note the metal melting point)

►Auto Ignition with Safety Lock- self-igniting with Piezo Ignition Technology and safety lock prevents accidental ignition. Unlock Safety Lock, Increase the flame, Press button to light fire, slide the Safety Lock to the right to lock fire. Then you release your hand, the fire will still keep igniting, finger free.
►Adjustable Flame Control - adjust the temperature regulator to completely control flame, up to 1300 °C/2372 °F.

►Refillable Torch- Refill the cooking torch with butane (BUTANE GAS ONLY), reusable. GAS IS NOT INCLUDED IN. Note - Please turn the safety lock toward "LOCK" to close flame torch and tune temperature regulator lowest, when you are not using it..
